item.title: Why Singapore’s PAP internal vote is the wrong place to look for signs of leadership renewal
item.description: Singapore’s ruling People’s Action Party (PAP) has retained its core executive team in what is seen as a cautious approach despite pledges of renewal, with observers pointing to ministerial promotions as a better indication of leadership plans. item.title: Abby Choi’s remains found in flat reeking of disinfectant, murder trial hears
item.description: Warning: graphic content follows. Slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung’s dismembered remains were found inside a rural village flat that reeked of disinfectant when police arrived at the scene three days after the model’s alleged murder, a court has heard.
